messages.出血を付与する味方と組み、出血6以上の敵にS3「処断」を当てて最後のコインの与ダ: A Bleed attacker that works with Bleed-applying allies, then lands S3 Slay against enemies with at least 6 Bleed to increase its final Coin's damage. On the bench, Gambler also raises allies' damage.
messages.S3「処断」: 4コイン。Ⅰ〜Ⅲコインの表面的中時に出血1ずつ、Ⅳコインは対象の: **S3 — Slay**: 4 Coins. Coins Ⅰ–Ⅲ each inflict 1 Bleed on Heads Hit, and Coin Ⅳ deals +20% damage if the target has at least 6 Bleed. +1 Skill Power if her SP is below 0.
messages.出血の付与: S1「振り下ろす」はⅠコインで出血2、S2「連続斬り」はⅠ・Ⅱコイ: **Inflicting Bleed**: S1 Strike Down inflicts 2 Bleed with Coin Ⅰ, and S2 Axe Combo inflicts 2 Bleed each with Coins Ⅰ and Ⅱ (Coin Ⅱ also adds +1 Bleed Count on Heads Hit).
messages.バトルパッシブ「断悪」(憤怒×5・保有): 攻撃的中時、50%の確率で出血1を付: **Combat passive — Split Evil (5 Wrath Owned)**: On hit, 50% chance to inflict 1 Bleed. The many Coins of S3 give it more attempts.
messages.サポートパッシブ「賭博師」(憤怒×5・保有・同期化Ⅲで取得): 控えにいるとき、: **Support passive — Gambler (5 Wrath Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅲ)**: While in backup, Coins that land Heads deal +20% damage for the 1 ally with the highest current HP.
messages.自分だけで付与できる出血は1スキルあたり2〜4程度なので、出血を付与する人格と組: She can only inflict about 2–4 Bleed per skill on her own, so she shines when paired with Identities that inflict Bleed. Bring enemy Bleed to 6 or more with S1, S2, and allies' infliction, then land S3. Bleed damage ignores resistances, so she can be fielded even when the team lacks Identities that can hit weaknesses. Even when she is not deployed, if the team can hold 5 Wrath, she is worth keeping in backup for Gambler.
